s_01: Dawn on a wide river in very dense fog, the water and the sky melting into one grey; a muddy sandy bank with washed-up branches and a broken boat plank in the foreground; two small figures seen from behind, a man and a woman in wet peasant clothes, standing apart in the fog, just finding each other
s_06: Night beside an old salt-boilers' log hut on a hill: a low stove of stones freshly plastered with wet clay, a fire glowing in its mouth, and on top a wide shallow rusty iron pan, steam rising from it into the dark; a bucket and tools nearby
s_07: A drowned grove: dead black oaks without bark standing knee-deep in still dark water, twisted roots and snags, a cold mist between the trunks, grey morning light
s_15: An old stone and timber dam across a marsh river with three wooden sluice gates and big iron-bound winches; one gate just opened and water roaring through it in white foam; dusk
s_16: On top of an old stone dam at dusk, seen from behind two small figures (a man and a woman, backs to the viewer) facing, some paces away, a broad man in a long white cloak with two big grey dogs beside him; wind, the river below; a tense standoff; the man in white is in shadow, his face not visible
s_31: Deep cart ruts in the mud leading out of a reed marsh up onto dry steppe of grey wormwood and feather grass, a wide beaten road far on the horizon, a huge sky, midday
s_37: Night: clay pits behind a long wooden fence with a gate, a wooden watchtower with a single lantern, the marsh beyond under a dark sky; quiet and tense
s_42: Midnight at a salt-works seen from inside its palisade: the wooden gate closed and barred, a big shaggy grey dog standing alert facing it, a man with a cudgel in shadow by the gate seen from behind, and beyond the sharpened stakes in the dark a row of torches of men waiting
s_47: Dusk at a ford into a wooded ravine on the steppe: two loaded ox carts with big wooden wheels waiting at the water, oxen standing, and in the dark bushes of the ravine several pairs of wolf eyes glinting
s_104: From the dark edge of a wide ravine at night, looking down on a military camp: rows of tents, a horse line, lantern light, and between the tents hundreds of men in identical grey shirts standing in long silent rows, all small and distant
s_108: Dawn on an empty steppe road: four ox carts crowded with people in grey shirts rolling north, seen from behind and a little above, a pale cold sky and long shadows
pm_s01: Late afternoon at the edge of a small southern river town: a heavy oak double gate in a whitewashed wattle fence; above the gate hangs a big key carved from oak wood as a craftsman's sign; smoke rises from a forge chimney behind the fence, cherry trees lean over it; in the foreground a lone young traveller seen from behind, with a small cloth bundle and a walking staff, about to knock
pm_s08: Night inside a village smithy: the forge glows low and red, on the anvil lies a freshly forged iron branding ring with three dots inside it, hammers and tongs beside it; the rest of the smithy sinks into deep shadow; through the open door, a dark yard and a single star; a quiet moment of a hard choice
pm_s12: Night: a craftsman's workshop and its orchard on the edge of a river town on fire, the thatched roof of the smithy in flames, cherry and pear trees burning like candles, sparks and thick smoke; in the foreground, seen from behind, a lone figure with a small bundle walks away up a dusty road; far ahead on the road, a few small dark figures of fleeing people
ph_s06: Night in a vast reed marsh under a half moon: four covered wagons under rough bast matting crawl along a narrow ridge through knee-deep black water, strong horses, drivers with caps pulled low, one hooded lantern; tall reeds on both sides; everything unnaturally silent and still
ph_s12: Day at a wide river crossing: a big flat wooden ferry raft leaving the bank, packed with rows of people in identical grey shirts standing perfectly still, small copper tags glinting at their necks, a few soldiers in blue coats at the rails; willow thickets on the far bank; seen from the near bank past the shoulder of a lone hunter with a bow, from behind
ph_s15: Dusk over a marsh: on a low island ridge a small hut, a smokehouse and nets on poles are catching fire, thick smoke rolls over the water; an old man sits small and still on the bank in front of the hut, a dark silhouette; in the foreground a narrow flat-bottomed boat is pushed off into the reeds with a pole, the boatman seen from behind, a few huddled figures in the boat
